standing_summary: The Stablecoins Ordinance has been in force since 1 August 2025, requiring a licence to issue fiat-referenced stablecoins in or pegged to the Hong Kong dollar. Licensees must maintain paid-up share capital of at least HK$25 million, back issued stablecoins with reserve assets at least equal to their par value at all times, and honour redemption requests at par, generally within one business day. Interested applicants were asked to submit applications by 30 September 2025 for early consideration, and on 10 April 2026 HKMA granted the first two licences -- to Anchorpoint Financial Limited and The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited. As of 28 April 2026, HKMA confirmed neither licensee had yet issued a stablecoin in the market and warned the public about fraudulent tokens falsely trading on their names.

open_items: Whether HKMA grants further licences beyond the initial two is unresolved; HKMA has described the eventual total number as likely to remain very limited.
Neither licensee has stated a specific product launch date; both have indicated a general window of mid-to-second-half 2026.
How virtual asset trading platforms may offer these stablecoins for trading is governed by a separate SFC circular (see the Exchanges (VATP) pillar).

A 14 August 2025 joint HKMA/SFC statement titled 'Joint Statement by the HKMA and the SFC on Stablecoin-related Market Movements' predates the regime's first licences (10 Apr 2026); HKMA's press-release page returned no retrievable content on every attempt made on 31 Jul 2026 (the same HKMA-wide access problem logged in the Banking & Money pillar's open_items across several recent updates), so the specific market movements it addresses remain unconfirmed against primary source text and should be checked directly once the site is reachable.

On 1 Aug 2026, while drafting dedicated cards for two queued items directly concerning this pillar -- the 28 Jul 2025 HKMA press release announcing implementation of the stablecoin issuer regulatory regime, and a 27 May 2026 HKMA circular titled 'Relevant Stablecoin-related Activities' -- both www.hkma.gov.hk and brdr.hkma.gov.hk were found unreachable (no retrievable content and HTTP 503 respectively) across multiple attempts, continuing the same HKMA-wide access problem logged above and in the Banking & Money pillar's open_items. A control fetch of SFC's site succeeded at the same time. For the first item, a working alternate official mirror was subsequently found and used: the same press release is republished on www.info.gov.hk (a listed GovHK official domain, and the DATA.GOV.HK/GovHK alternate route CLAUDE.md's Sources table documents for HKMA press releases), confirmed via two independent fetches including a verbatim-only re-check; its card was re-derived and cited from that mirror instead of the unreachable hkma.gov.hk link. The second item (the stablecoin-related-activities circular, hosted only on brdr.hkma.gov.hk) has no known alternate mirror and remains drafted from its official title alone; it should be re-confirmed against primary text once brdr.hkma.gov.hk is reachable again.
